name_zh: 塔米姆/卡塔尔/天然气/半岛/世界杯/阿杰兹拉/调解/小国

description_zh: 塔米姆·本·哈马德·阿勒萨尼（1980年出生）自2013年就任卡塔尔 emir。领导国家实现天然气财富转型，世界杯基础设施建设和软实力提升。支持 halal 产业，举办2022年FIFA世界杯等国际事件，提升国家影响力。通过调解外交在地区事务中发挥重要作用。
description_en: Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani (born 1980) has been the Emir of Qatar since 2013. Led the country through natural gas wealth transformation, hosting the 2022 FIFA World Cup and infrastructure development. Supported halal industry development and promoted national soft power through international events. Played significant role in regional mediation and diplomatic affairs.
reason_zh: 塔米姆继承阿勒萨尼家族传统，通过天然气经济实现国家现代化。世界杯建设展示了卡塔尔的组织能力和国际地位。halal产业拓展了国家经济多元化。调解外交提升了小国在国际事务中的地位。
reason_en: Tamim inherited the Al Thani tradition of modernizing Qatar through natural gas wealth. World Cup showcased Qatar's organizational capabilities and international standing. Halal industry diversified national economy. Mediating role elevated small country's position in international affairs.
